output.headline: Generating your own electricity with solar panels
output.text: Your electricity use is on the high side at 4,320 kWh per year, with 2,160 kWh used per household member. Your income profile of Q3 is also a factor we considered. By generating your own power, you could see an estimated impact of about 144 kg CO2e per year and about 998 kWh of energy per year.
